title: Vehicle Testing Engineer
description:

Body and Passive Safety Development: shape the safety standards of tomorrow with our avant-garde projects.

ADAS and Brakes Testing: immerse yourself in the forefront of automotive technology, testing advanced driver assistance systems and brakes.

Functional Safety and Cybersecurity: contribute to the critical fields of functional safety and cybersecurity, safeguarding the future of connected vehicles.

Electronics HW and SW Development: be at the heart of electronic innovation, developing cutting-edge hardware and software solutions.

Homologation: navigate the regulatory landscape as we pave the way for compliant and revolutionary vehicles.

With facilities in Cambridge and the Midlands, we're at the forefront of automotive innovation throughout the UK.

Job Description

To support the continuing expansion of IDIADA activities in the UK, we are seeking a Vehicle Test Engineer to join our team.

This role will be based in Nuneaton, United Kingdom, and it will be responsible for working on vehicle testing project activities on both open road and proving ground environments. The role covers a wide range of vehicle functionalities including, but not limited to: ADAS, Vehicle Durability, Field Operational Testing, Electric Vehicle Chargers, Infotainment Systems, Brakes, Vehicle Dynamics, Connectivity, and Automated Driving.

The main tasks of the role include:

  • Discussion and confirmation of technical requirements with the customer, including communication throughout the whole test program from project conceptualisation through to delivery.
  • Leading the complete testing project execution, including:
    • Discussion and confirmation of technical requirements with the customer up to proposal release
    • Test project planning and coordination within the team/customer, including the definition and arrangement of vehicle logistics, test location booking, test route/programme, instrumentation...
    • Test sample preparation and instrumentation.
    • Test preparation, operation and data acquisition set-up.
    • Test execution according to the defined procedures and specifications.
    • Test data analysis, validation and reporting.
    • Test preparation: coordinate the required test preparation tasks, such as vehicle inspection, instrumentation, together with test drivers and/or technicians.
    • Test execution: lead test execution according to the defined procedures and specifications, including coordination of test drivers and/or technicians, liaison with test location management…
    • Test data collection, validation, analysis and reporting according to test/customer procedure requirements. Concern analysis and troubleshooting supported by IDIADA experts.
    • Support business development activities.
    • Ensure alignment with corporate procedures in terms of the management of the project, test samples, test equipment/facilities, quality, OHS, logistics, outsourcing/purchasing…
    • Executing and/or supervising hands-on automotive and mechanical jobs related to chassis, engine, body, bracketry fabrication…
    • To flexibly support other related activities as required by the business.
    • On occasion, supporting non-UK-based testing might be required by the company (eg at IDIADA’s proving ground in Spain).

    Qualifications

    Desired profile

    • University engineering degree, preferably with Automotive specialisation.
    • Substantial background in automotive technology and vehicle systems, preferably with around 3-5 years’ experience.
    • Good knowledge of the UK road network and testing infrastructures nationwide (ie proving grounds).
    • Available to travel within the UK and abroad as per project requirements.
    • Must have a full manual UK driving license. Having a test-driving qualification is an asset, but training will be provided as required.
    • Experience with test equipment use (i.e. sensors, data acquisition, driving robots, ADAS platforms) and management (i.e calibration) is also an asset.
    • Proactive and thorough hands-on engineer able to work efficiently both within the team and alone.
    • Relevant experience in vehicle Durability, ADAS, Brakes or Vehicle Dynamics testing is an asset.
    • The ability to be flexible and responsive to customer needs is essential.
    • Dynamic, focused, dedicated and self-motivated with a high level of initiative and a problem-solving mindset.
    • Good experience in MS-Office.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
Company Overview

Filtronic is a UK-headquartered designer and manufacturer of high-performance RF, microwave and mmWave components, modules and subsystems for mission-critical communication, sensing and space applications. Its technologies operate from 300 MHz to 175 GHz and are deployed across aerospace and defence, space, telecommunications infrastructure and critical communications platforms worldwide.

Filtronic's investment in high calibre people, advanced technology and world-class manufacturing facilities underpins its growth strategy and ambition to be a leading supplier of high-frequency solutions.

Role Overview

Filtronic is seeking a Quality Assurance Engineer to support and enhance the quality of its products, processes and systems within a highly regulated aerospace, defence and telecommunications environment.

This role is responsible for ensuring compliance with quality management systems, supporting product and process assurance across the full lifecycle, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. The position will work closely with engineering, manufacturing, supply chain and customer teams to ensure that products meet stringent regulatory, customer and internal requirements.

Aligned with leading aerospace organisations, this role combines quality systems assurance, product lifecycle quality support and audit-driven continuous improvement, ensuring robust quality performance from design through to production and delivery.

Key Responsibilities

Quality Systems and Compliance

  • Maintain and continuously improve the Quality Management System (QMS) in line with ISO9001 and AS9100 standards.
  • Ensure compliance with customer, regulatory and industry requirements across all operations.
  • Plan, coordinate and conduct internal audits, supporting external and customer audits.
  • Support the development, implementation and improvement of quality policies, procedures and systems.

Product and Process Assurance

  • Support product quality throughout the full lifecycle (design, development, manufacturing and delivery).
  • Review and approve engineering and manufacturing documentation to ensure compliance with quality standards.
  • Monitor product performance, including yield, defects and non-conformance trends.
  • Drive root cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) to address quality issues.
  • Work closely with engineering teams to ensure robust design assurance and manufacturability.

Continuous Improvement and Data Analysis

  • Analyse quality data and metrics to identify trends, risks and improvement opportunities.
  • Lead and support continuous improvement initiatives, driving efficiency, yield and cost reduction.
  • Apply structured quality tools (e.g. SPC, FMEA, 8D) to improve processes and product reliability.
  • Monitor QMS performance and report on compliance and improvement activities to management.

Audit, Investigation and Risk Management

  • Conduct audits of processes, products and systems to ensure compliance with internal and external standards.
  • Lead investigations into non-conformances, failures and customer issues, ensuring effective resolution.
  • Support risk management activities, ensuring risks to product quality and delivery are identified and mitigated.
  • Maintain calibration, inspection and certification processes in line with industry standards.

Supplier and Customer Quality

  • Support supplier quality assurance, including audits, performance monitoring and issue resolution.
  • Act as a key interface between customers, suppliers and internal teams on quality matters.
  • Support customer reporting, audits and compliance activities, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction.
  • Provide guidance and training to internal teams on quality standards and best practices.

Documentation and Governance

  • Develop and maintain quality documentation, including procedures, work instructions and audit records.
  • Ensure robust configuration control and documentation management processes are followed.
  • Support the implementation of changes to quality systems, processes and policies.

Requirements

Skills and Experience

  • Degree (or equivalent experience) in Engineering, Physics, Manufacturing or a related discipline.
  • Experience in a quality assurance or quality engineering role, ideally within aerospace, defence or high-technology manufacturing.
  • Strong knowledge of quality management systems (ISO9001 / AS9100) and audit processes.
  • Experience supporting product development and manufacturing lifecycles in a regulated environment.
  • Familiarity with quality tools such as SPC, FMEA, root cause analysis and CAPA.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and data interpretation skills.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams in engineering and manufacturing environments.
  • Knowledge of RF/microwave products or electronics manufacturing is advantageous.

Personal Attributes

  • High attention to detail with a strong commitment to quality and compliance.
  • Process-driven mindset with a focus on continuous improvement and operational excellence.
  • Strong communicator, able to work effectively across engineering, manufacturing and customer teams.
  • Proactive, organised and able to manage multiple priorities.
  • Resilient and comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-reliability environment.

Additional Information

  • Occasional travel (UK and Europe) may be required.
  • Eligibility for UK security clearance is required.

Benefits

Please call our Talent Partner, Bruce Mair on 07483 917543 if you would like to chat about this role or clarify the salary and benefits prior to investing your time applying. You may request a job description by emailing: talent@filtronic.com

Filtronic plc is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.   • In conjunction with the Quality Assurance Manager, assists with the planning, development, and administration of quality assurance/control systems.

  • Analyze testing and inspection procedures to ensure adequacy and compliance.

  • Diagnosing and correcting improper quality control practices using metrology and statistical methods. Conducts capability studies of plant and supplier manufacturing processes.

  • Audits internal quality systems for deficiencies.

  • Review engineering drawings and specifications to ensure the measurability of key features. Review tolerances of key features to ensure manufacturability. Define measurement methods at plants and suppliers to establish consistency of measurement. 

  • Represent the QA department in new projects, as required. Aid team in reviewing customer specifications, project-specific quality planning and supplier coordination. 

  • Develops Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs) for existing and new products and coordinate implementation with plant Quality Assurance personnel. Includes new testing/inspection techniques and fixture/gauge design. 

  • Using established specifications, evaluates finished products, purchased products, and raw materials.

  • Utilizes physical, mechanical, and electrical testing procedures and inspection equipment to perform routine Quality/Materials Lab tasks. 

  • Interprets engineering recommendations, customer specifications, and engineering drawings for suppliers or PLP facilities.

  • Conducts source inspection of suppliers. Conducts supplier Quality System audits. Works with key suppliers to implement required improvements. 

  • Investigates field complaints and product failures. Analyzes problems, solutions, or recommendations after proper engineering and laboratory studies. Helps to determine causes of material failures.

  • Assists engineers and plant personnel in reducing the instances of nonconformities and the quantity of non-conforming product produced in the plants. Uses Root Cause Analysis and Corrective and Preventive Action tools to effect improvements. Drives reduction in component, WIP, and finished good nonconformities through improvements in process controls, better gauging methods, and product specification rationalization. Follows up on a regular basis until improvements have been verified.

  • Assists suppliers who are having difficulty with meeting Quality expectations due to part non-conformance. Uses Root Cause Analysis and Corrective and Preventive Action tools to effect improvements. Follows up with suppliers on a regular basis until improvements have been verified.

  • Develops and conducts material test procedures to comply with industry and customer specifications. Prepares and performs analysis in support of product development. 

  • Maintains the Supplier Risk Assessment and Inspection Level programs. 

  • Provides support of the Customer Feedback database and follows up with Engineering, PLP plants, suppliers, and Marketing and Sales to verify that an answer has been provided. 

  • Has familiarity with and implements Lean techniques for continuous improvement.

  • Attends technical meetings, conferences, and specialized courses consistent with area of responsibility.

  • Effectively identifies and uses software tools as appropriate to the task.

  • Bachelor of Science Degree in a technical curriculum required with an Industrial or Manufacturing Engineering Degree preferred. 

  • ASQ Quality Engineering Certification or Auditor Certification is desired, but not required.

Wing offers drone delivery as a safe, fast, and sustainable solution for last mile logistics. Consumer appetites for on-demand services are increasing, but current delivery methods are inefficient, costly, and contribute to road accidents and air pollution. Wing’s fleet of highly automated delivery drones can transport small packages directly from businesses to homes on-demand, in minutes. Wing is a part of Google's parent company, Alphabet, and our mission is to create the preferred means of delivery for the planet. If you're ready to do the greatest work of your life, come join us.

About The Role

Wing is looking for an Embedded Software Engineer to join our Flight Systems team. This role will be based in Palo Alto, CA. As an Embedded Software Engineer, you will use your experience developing working with large systems and physical devices to enable the next-generation of unmanned technology. In this role, you will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams of electrical, mechanical, computer vision, backend services, and GNC (Guidance, Navigation, and Control) engineers. You will develop and maintain the system of applications that forms the platform of the vehicle software. Your work will span from the cloud back-end to Linux application development and bare metal programming on the aircraft to form a cohesive system.

What You’ll Do

  • Work with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and define architectures for new vehicle software.
  • Drive new software frameworks and features through the full software lifecycle - design, implementation, validation and roll-out to production.
  • Root cause and resolve problems being seen in production using remote fleet diagnostics, local hardware and test automation platforms.
  • Develop and maintain vehicle software modules interfacing with sensors, hardware accelerators, cameras, motors, and servos.
  • Plan and execute test procedures to verify software performance at all levels of integration on the vehicle.
  • Maintain and improve embedded build infrastructure and automated test environments.

What You’ll Need

  • Demonstrated experience writing multi-threaded, highly reliable code with components that span different systems and environments.
  • 3-6+ years of experience programming with C/C++ in a Linux, RTOS and/or bare metal environment.
  • Understanding of structured software development processes (code reviews, version control, unit test development, on-hardware test & debugging).
  • Ability to independently work with cross-functional teams to drive features to completion.
  • Experience with one or more of:
    • Backend software development, especially as it pertains to interfacing with a fleet of physical devices.
    • Embedded programming, RTOS development, bare metal systems.
    • Linux platform and application development experience, especially with realtime and/or robotics considerations.
